component.name: Shift
component.summary: FTP, FTPS and SFTP file transfer client
FTP, FTPS ve SFTP dosya aktarım istemcisi

description.p: Shift is a modern, lightweight file transfer client for FTP, FTPS and SFTP servers.
Shift, FTP, FTPS ve SFTP sunucuları için modern ve hafif bir dosya aktarım istemcisidir.

ul.li: Saved servers as cards, with a quick-connect bar
Remote file browser with upload, download, rename and delete
Light and dark mode that follow the desktop
